title: Patch: remove the damage cracks from a unit's art
notes: Issue #3776: a damaged unit's art no longer draws cracks for the health it is missing, while the buffed glow and the frozen frost stay. Under apps/web/src/cards/art/ the wear.ts cracks, the ART_WEAR_LEVELS constant and the .cf-art-cracks styles are deleted (R3340000, amended by R3776000). How cards play is unchanged.

fixes: A damaged unit's art no longer shows cracks; its health number says it is hurt, and the buff glow and freeze frost stay.
